newsitem.title: USA: Lawter buys Hercules ink resins arm.
newsitem.headline: Lawter buys Hercules ink resins arm.

text.p: Lawter International Inc said on Wednesday it had completed its acquisition of Hercules Inc's rosin-based ink resins business, a specialty segment of Hercules Resins Division.
Specifically, Lawter bought Hercules' U.S. and European lithographic resin business and the U.S. resinates business for publication gravure printing.
Terms were not disclosed. The two companies had signed a letter of intent last July.

During a transition period, Hercules will make rosin-based ink resins for Lawter. Afterwards, Lawter will transfer production to new polymer plants located in Pleasant Prairie, Wis., and in Kallo, Belgium.

Lawter makes specialty chemicals, including printing ink vehicles, wax compounds and resins, and colors for graphics arts and other industries. Hercules, based on Wilmington, Del., also makes various specialty chemical products.
